channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Daniel Theis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Daniel Theis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Daniel Theis
item.description:

item.title: Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis
item.description:
Brad Stevens:

“We need Tristan (Thompson) back. We saw that last night. With the Theis trade, that is enormous to have him back.”

Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis
item.description:
Stevens on Theis:

“You really feel for him....we’re gonna miss him on the court but he’ll have a full recovery.”

Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis, Mar 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Daniel Theis
item.description:
#Celtics Marcus Morris on Daniel Theis tearing meniscus:

“That really hurt me because he played well. He's a great dude, a great teammate, always coming to work. For something like that to happen is definitely tough. It's just the #NBA, man.”

Marcus Morris on Daniel Theis, Mar 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @Scott_Souza.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis
item.description:
Jay King:Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis:

“I’d like to claim development, but I don’t know that we’re in the business of development.... He came with everything he’s doing.”

Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis, Feb 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis:

“He has been terrific. He has come in, played his role … He never changes. That’s a real good quality.”

Brad Stevens on Daniel Theis, Jan 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.
